all_articles.html:
Elliptic Equations 椭圆方程

a_1u_{xx} + a_2u_{xy} + a_3u_{yy} + a_4u_x + a_5u_y + a_6u = f

其中

a_2^2 - 4a_1a_3 < 0

3.1 Steady-state heat conduction 稳态导热

u_t = (\kappa u_x)_x + (\kappa u_y)_y + \psi

稳态解

(\kappa u_x)_x + (\kappa u_y)_y =f

3.2 The 5-point stencil for the Laplacian

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

grid = np.linspace(0, 1, 7)
plt.hlines(grid, 0, 1)
plt.vlines(grid, 0, 1)
plt.axis('equal')
plt.xlim([-0.1, 1.1])
plt.ylim([-0.1, 1.1])
已保存输出 / Saved output
(-0.1, 1.1)


def plt_conv_ker(conv_ker):
    plt.imshow(conv_ker)
    plt.axis('off')
    for i, h in enumerate(conv_ker):
        for j, e in enumerate(h):
            if e != 0:
                plt.text(i, j, e, fontdict={'fontsize':24})


conv_ker1 = np.array([
    [0, 1, 0],
    [1, -4, 1],
    [0, 1, 0],
])

plt_conv_ker(conv_ker1)


conv_ker2 = np.array([
    [1, 4, 1],
    [4, -20, 4],
    [1, 4, 1]
])
plt_conv_ker(conv_ker2)


import cv2 as cv

plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
loli = cv.imread("loli.png", flags=0)
print(loli.shape)

plt.subplot(131)
plt.imshow(loli, cmap='gray')
plt.axis('off')

plt.subplot(132)
conv_loli = cv.filter2D(loli, -1, conv_ker1, borderType=cv.BORDER_CONSTANT)
plt.imshow(256-conv_loli, cmap='gray')
plt.axis('off')

plt.subplot(133)
conv_loli = cv.filter2D(loli, -1, conv_ker2/6, borderType=cv.BORDER_CONSTANT)
plt.imshow(256-conv_loli, cmap='gray')
plt.axis('off')

plt.show()
